title: Sphinx outcrop was always visible from the Nile

tellings.quote: this thing. This is a huge limestone outcropping that they always had to have known was there.

plain: Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient Egypt, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that the Sphinx was carved from a huge outcrop of limestone rock. He argues that the people of the region must always have known that rock was there, which, as he frames it, bears on how early it could have been shaped.
